description: TradingView strategy tapes of synthetic probes pinning margin-call, admission and sizing rules. One entry per tape: fixture path, original export path, sha256 of the exported trade list and of the Pine source, export time, export tool and channel. Tapes with repeat_tv_trades_sha256 were exported twice; both exports were byte-identical. "feed_set": "own-feed" tapes read the feeds exported with them; the factorial, fee-sizing and order-control tapes were exported two to four times, all byte-identical. order_controls lists the order controls the test replays with handwritten hosts, each with its bars/ window.
